correctness.rationale: Uniform n>=9 common-neighbor intersection proof makes 2n free collapse pairs; the terminal connected triangulated surface has V=n,E=3n,F=2n, every vertex link a 6-cycle, a primitive orientation cycle, and hence H_1=Z^2 and H_2=Z. Rotation signed Lefschetz L=0 and reflection signed Lefschetz L=4 follow from exact fixed-face counts; H_2 action trivial, and finite order forces integral H_1 matrices I and -I. Finite quotient rational cohomology is computed using characteristic-zero averaging. Actual embedded verify.py passed 72 sample n and 6408 group element traces; these finite checks are corroboration only.

originality.rationale: The only claimed novelty is the uniform integral dihedral action on H_1 and H_2 of the open neighborhood complex of C_n^2, plus its full quotient rational cohomology. Kozlov 2005 supplies elementary neighborhood-complex collapse methodology. Shukla 2018 covers the nonequivariant four-regular circulant surface models, and that known implication is explicitly excluded from novelty. Full relevant Shukla arguments were inspected and do not calculate induced dihedral homology operators or the symmetry quotient. Index searches and published text comparisons found no statement implying the claimed integral module, while unindexed equivalent work remains a named risk. Datta and Upadhyay (first public 2004-03-25) explicitly constructed the identical torus T_{n,1,2} and its dihedral automorphism group; these facts are excluded from novelty. No action on integral homology is stated in its inspected results.
residual_risks: A distinct equivariant theorem or straightforward but unpublished specialization might give the same matrices.
A different automorphism group for special small n is irrelevant to the asserted natural D_n action, but not classified.
An equivalent calculation in an unindexed non-English dissertation or book could evade the searches.
